title: Entry
description: One item from an RSS/Atom feed, first-seen frozen (immutable, hash-stable). The feed is the artifact: the provider fetches only feed URLs and stores feed-provided content verbatim. Publisher edits surface as revision Note facts; enclosures are pointers, never downloaded.

entry_id.description: Stable item identity (guid / atom:id / rdf:about / normalized link / hash(title+published)). Dedup key is (metadata.feed, entry_id) — guids are only unique per feed.

examples: Feed readers which don't take 'no' for an answer

published.description: Entry date, ISO 8601 UTC (pubDate/published; updated preferred when there is no published)

updated.description: Last-modified time, ISO 8601 UTC — NOT an HTTP validator (the NextCloud-News anti-pattern); used only for revision detection.

description.description: Feed-provided content verbatim, untruncated. Untrusted third-party HTML; renderers must treat it as such.

content_type.description: text/plain | text/html (default html when description present)

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of description (hex); keeps revision detection off the big columns

enclosures.description: Pointers only — never downloaded. {url, type, length}.
